title: Convert between ints and standard Roman numerals
levels: Meets every requirement in the brief
Misses at least one requirement in the brief

cases.rationale: The greedy table gives the standard numeral for every int from 1 to 3999, and a lookup built from to_roman makes from_roman its exact inverse that rejects every other string.
It describes both functions and claims they were tested but delivers no code at all.
Digit tables produce the standard numerals, and from_roman accepts only full matches of the standard pattern before summing, so it is the exact inverse of to_roman.
from_roman checks only the characters, so non-standard forms such as "IIII" and "IC" return 4 and 99 instead of raising ValueError.
